Founded in 2018, Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University is a private university. It is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh. The institute is accredited with PCI and AICTE. Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University provides UG, PG and After 10th courses in both Full Time and Part Time modes. It provides 129 courses across specialisations such as Automobile Engineering, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Botany and Chemistry. Some of the courses offered at this institute include B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, Executive MBA/PGDM and B.Sc. Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University fees ranges between INR 12,500 to 3,99,000. The student intake for these courses is 5998. Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University offers these course across fields such as Engineering, Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce and Design. Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University offers all the campus facilities to students.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Our college provides good education and campus life.

review_content.Placements: Our college provides excellent placements. The lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA and the highest salary package offered is 11 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The library is excellent. More than 5,000 books are available in the library. All departments have their libraries, so you can easily find books according to your needs. University has four central libraries.
review_content.Faculty: The pattern of exams at this university is good. Question papers are prepared by teachers. The teaching quality is good. Our teachers are well-educated. They complete the entire course in chapters.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: This college is the best of all time; its faculty is good. Its placement is better.

review_content.Placements: In our college placement rate of 90%, this is the highest rate in our country. There are mostly the highest packages offered in our college, ranging from INR 50 lacs to 2.5 lacs per annum. Cipla, Lupin, and Reddy's Laboratory are the other three most popular recruiting firms. In 2016, 60% of students got internships at CIPA. The top roles are analytical chemist, food and drug inspector, and drug therapist.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a highly digital Wi-Fi connection for better studies. Also, its labs are wonderful and clean. The hostel is very clean, and the food is very tasty and healthy. And in the sports category, our college ranks in the No. 1 position. And there are many more games like chess, carrom, football, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Helpful faculty, Decent Infrastructure, But No connectivity to the main city.

review_content.Placements: There can be better opportunities for the students. I believe the current placement structure doesn't put much emphasis on getting the students good packages. From what I've seen, a very small percentage of students get places with decent packages. Scope for improvement!
review_content.Infrastructure: I haven't been to the hostel, but for my course, we're placed in the B block, and I guess all the blocks have fully functional elevator, the classrooms are tidy, but it can be tough to sit there for prolonged hours during summer. I guess, rest is fine.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: It is an excellent learning institute in Raipur.

review_content.Placements: In our college, almost 80% of students got placed. The lowest salary package offered was 3 LPA and the highest salary package offered was 20 LPA. Top recruiting companies visited our campus. Almost 80% of students got internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities were average. The quality of the food was good. Sports were excellent. The library was good. The seating arrangement was excellent. Many books were available.
review_content.Faculty: The teaching quality was excellent. Lectures were beneficial for students. The course curriculum was relevant. Almost 60% of students were industry-ready. Semester exams were easy. The pass percentage was 80%.

faqs.question: Is BA LLB available in CCS University?
faqs.answer: Chaudhary Charan Singh University offers an integrated BA LLB programme for a duration of five-year. The self-financed BA LLB programme is divided into 10 semesters. review_content.Placements: GNIOT placement is average, according to me. The average package is 2 LPA-4 LPA, and the highest package is 12 LPA. review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are good and fully air-conditioned but the internet connectivity is too poor. There is a separate library and lab for each department. The college grounds are not too big but they are decent and the cafeteria is also good with a reasonable price.

reviews_list.review_title: Review of Janhit Institute of Education & Information.

review_content.Placements: There are not many placements, but there is a small placement cell. Our course companies do not come for placements, but we get support of getting internships in schools. Almost every student has to do an internship, which is provided by the college, and it is compulsory.
review_content.Infrastructure: It is not so good and not so bad, but moderate for students who just have to do a degree without getting involved in any other academic activities. There is a library section in the college and a computer lab too. There are no medical facilities in the college. There is a small canteen. There are no sports and games areas, as it is just a college for those who just want a degree.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: It is the worst college, but one thing is good, that there is no pressure for attendance.

review_content.Placements: There are no placements. Even small companies do not come. Even TCS company does not visit here. There is no competition in the tech-related field. Even the hackathon team is not selected from my college, besides students participating. It does not conduct any tour, and we will not get the college life that we hope for.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a small room and three people have to live there. The mess food is worse than stall food. There is no canteen. Hostel timing for girls in the evening is only 6:00 PM. Staff and matrons are very rude and go against our character. Bathrooms are also very dirty.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: All over, good college, good infrastructure and good campus life.

review_content.Placements: Placement is very good for those students who studied very well, and placement is good. The highest package is 44 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The percentage of students who placed is 83%. Top recruiters include companies like Paytm, Axis Bank, EY, and all in CSE (AI). The package is high compared to the CSE core.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a hostel facility. 24/7 Wi-Fi is available. A gym is available. The quality of food is not very good because it is not nutritious. The canteen meal is overall good, but the prices of canteen food are high, not too high but still high. Sports activities include cricket, badminton, volleyball, etc.

review_summary.college_name: CCSU Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: They give placement, good faculty, they help, so you can go for it.

content.Placements: Not much student percentage are placed, but this year in BBA, 200 plus companies have come for interviews. If you failed, they will train you on how to sit in interviews. The highest is 8 LPA in BBA, the lowest is 2 LPA. Companies include Bajaj Finance, Agile, etc. There are more. Around 80 percent placements in BBA, B. Tech, PGDM, BCA, MBA.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. Lifts are there, AC in almost every class. Teachers are also good at teaching. Labs are okay, library they have made quite good. Hostel rooms were good, food was average. Sports not happens much, games are less, only in first year happens.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Only for management students.

content.Placements: GNIOT placement is average, according to me. The average package is 2 LPA-4 LPA, and the highest package is 12 LPA. The main thing is that recruiters do not come from the big companies. The company that comes for placement is small, and almost all the students get the internships.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are good and fully air-conditioned but the internet connectivity is too poor. There is a separate library and lab for each department. The college grounds are not too big but they are decent and the cafeteria is also good with a reasonable price.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of Janhit Institute of Education & Information.

content.Placements: There are not many placements, but there is a small placement cell. Our course companies do not come for placements, but we get support of getting internships in schools. Almost every student has to do an internship, which is provided by the college, and it is compulsory.
content.Infrastructure: It is not so good and not so bad, but moderate for students who just have to do a degree without getting involved in any other academic activities. There is a library section in the college and a computer lab too. There are no medical facilities in the college. There is a small canteen. There are no sports and games areas, as it is just a college for those who just want a degree.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is the worst college, but one thing is good, that there is no pressure for attendance.

content.Placements: There are no placements. Even small companies do not come. Even TCS company does not visit here. There is no competition in the tech-related field. Even the hackathon team is not selected from my college, besides students participating. It does not conduct any tour, and we will not get the college life that we hope for.
content.Infrastructure: There is a small room and three people have to live there. The mess food is worse than stall food. There is no canteen. Hostel timing for girls in the evening is only 6:00 PM. Staff and matrons are very rude and go against our character. Bathrooms are also very dirty.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: All over, good college, good infrastructure and good campus life.

content.Placements: Placement is very good for those students who studied very well, and placement is good. The highest package is 44 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The percentage of students who placed is 83%. Top recruiters include companies like Paytm, Axis Bank, EY, and all in CSE (AI). The package is high compared to the CSE core.
content.Infrastructure: There is a hostel facility. 24/7 Wi-Fi is available. A gym is available. The quality of food is not very good because it is not nutritious. The canteen meal is overall good, but the prices of canteen food are high, not too high but still high. Sports activities include cricket, badminton, volleyball, etc.

library.description:
Ch. Charan Singh University (Formerly Meerut University) Library was established in 1968 to serve the academic community of the university in particular and this region of the state in general.

The mission of the library is to support fully the research and educational endeavors of the students, Research Scholars and faculty of this university and its affiliated colleges, by collecting, organizing, preserving, and disseminating information in any form, by providing effective service and instructional programs, and by utilizing electronic information systems to provide access to new information products and services.

In the matter of acquisition of books our policy has been to acquire books of immediate relevance and books useful for advance level research in the subject concerned. Our aim has been to build up a rounded collection of books to meet the teaching and research requirements.

Besides acquisition against payment, the library also received great books from Central and State Government International organization and individuals.

Following types of reading materials available here in CCU: 
144339 Number of Volumes  
96796 Number of Titles
26292 Bound Volumes of Journals
10300 Number of Ph.D. Theses
108 Current Foreign Journal
196 Current Indian Journals
67000 e-books
More than 8000 UGC Infonet Online e-journals
114 e-journals
2884 e-theses

The library remains open throughout the year (except all National holidays as prescribed in the Rules) working from 8 A.M. to 12 A.M.on all working days and from 8 A.M to 8 P.M on holidays. The study room of the library remains open from 8 A.M to 4 A.M. on all working days.

And also University have membership with INFLIBNET and DELNET so all members of the library are able to access the services offered by INFLIBNET and DELNET.

Ch. Charan Singh University (Formerly Meerut University) Library was established in 1968 to serve the academic community of the university in particular and this region of the state in general.

The mission of the library is to support fully the research and educational endeavors of the students, Research Scholars and faculty of this university and its affiliated colleges, by collecting, organizing, preserving, and disseminating information in any form, by providing effective service and instructional programs, and by utilizing electronic information systems to provide access to new information products and services.

In the matter of acquisition of books our policy has been to acquire books of immediate relevance and books useful for advance level research in the subject concerned. Our aim has been to build up a rounded collection of books to meet the teaching and research requirements.

Besides acquisition against payment, the library also received great books from Central and State Government International organization and individuals.

Following types of reading materials available here in CCU: 
144339 Number of Volumes  
96796 Number of Titles
26292 Bound Volumes of Journals
10300 Number of Ph.D. Theses
108 Current Foreign Journal
196 Current Indian Journals
67000 e-books
More than 8000 UGC Infonet Online e-journals
114 e-journals
2884 e-theses

The library remains open throughout the year (except all National holidays as prescribed in the Rules) working from 8 A.M. to 12 A.M.on all working days and from 8 A.M to 8 P.M on holidays. The study room of the library remains open from 8 A.M to 4 A.M. on all working days.

And also University have membership with INFLIBNET and DELNET so all members of the library are able to access the services offered by INFLIBNET and DELNET.

faqs.question: How to get admission in BTech course admission at Abacus Institute of Engineering and Management?
faqs.answer: Admission to the BTech course at Abacus Institute of Engineering and Management is based on JEE Main scores. The institute offers five BTech and five Lateral Entry courses. For Lateral Entry admission, aspirants must complete Class 12 with a 45% aggregate. If qualified, aspirants have to report to the college on the date given by the college authorities with the academic documents and all other relevant documents.

faqs.question: What is the BTech course duration at Abacus Institute of Engineering and Management?
faqs.answer: AIEM offer five full-time BTech courses and five Lateral Entry courses. The full-time course duration is four years and three years for Lateral Entry. The BTech courses are offered in various specialisations such asCSE, ECE, EE, ME etc. A total of 90 seats are available for BTech full-time courses, respectively.

faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for After 10th Diploma programme at AIEM is INR 88,000. The fee is sourced from unofficial sources and hence, is indicative. Apart from the tuition fee candidates might also have to pay one-time and registration fees. The institute offers four Diploma courses and four Diploma (Voc) courses.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Abacus Institute of Engineering and Management?
faqs.answer: Candidates should have passed Class 10 and Class 12 examination from a recognised board or its equivalent with a minimum of with 35%-45% aggregtae.AIEMcourse admissions selection criteria are entirely based on WBJEE, JEE Main, WBJEE JELET and JEXPO. Apart from this, the institute also offers four Diploma (Voc) course in the stream of Civil Engineering, EE, ME and CSE.

faqs.question: Is it easy to get admission in Abacus Institute of Engineering and Management?
faqs.answer: Admission to Abacus Institute of Engineering and Management is strictly on rank in JEE Main or WBJEE, category, and the branch one desires to pursue. This is a good college with decent placements, however, with very high competition for popular branches. One would advise checking the previous year's cut-offs and talking to your admission office to better understand your chances.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Average package, not bad infrastructure.

content.Placements: I am pursuing CSE from NMIET. I believe the university provides you with a lot of opportunities as well as exposure. The faculty at NMIET are top notch and dedicated to the careers of students. Students can have doubt sessions with the respective faculties even on Sundays. The placement rate is quite high as the university provides a number of opportunities with many companies and MNCs coming for campus placements and recruiting a large number of students. The university always tries its best to make students work easy by providing study material, mock tests and AMCAT preparation. I hope you achieve your dreams. Only 5 percent of students were placed this year with the highest package being 4 LPA and the average 2 LPA. TCS and Infosys have 10 percent of students getting internships in CSE Mechanical Engineering and MBA.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Our college campus is lucky for me and I am thankful to our teachers.

content.Placements: There are no good placements coming to our college. Good companies visit the college sometimes but the salary offered is less than Rs.30,000 per month. The college charges fees of Rs.75.000 per year. So it is slightly a better campus, and all the departments are good.
content.Infrastructure: Our classrooms are huge and have CCTV cameras and air-conditioned and fans available. The library is small, but all types of books are available. Wi-Fi is enabled on the entire campus, and hostel rooms are good. They serve better food. All types of sports are played in the college. The medical facilities provided are better.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college should provide many facilities.

content.Placements: Almost 90% of the students from our course got placed. The highest salary package offered is 2 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 1 LPA. TCS company recruited many students from our college. Almost 90% of the students from our course got an internship in TCS. A top role offered is a production in charge.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides many facilities like 24 hours free Wi-Fi, a library, air-conditioned classrooms, etc. Our college provides a hostel facility with good and healthy food. The environment is also good. The canteen is neat and clean. Our college provides medical facilities. The medical staff members are very helpful, and they also help us in every situation.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: This college provides good placements and faculty members.

content.Placements: Approximately 80%of the students get placed from our course. The highest salary offered was of Rs. 30,000 per month. TCS, Tech Mahindra and Thomson digital were the top recruiting companies. System engineer and production head were the roles offered. The salary package offered in our course was 10 LPA. Around 75% of the students got an internship in Indian railways and Mitsubishi motors.
content.Infrastructure: The college is Wi-Fi enabled. Classrooms are good. There are two fields in college for sports. The hostel and mess are very good. The quality of the food served is good and not too bad like other colleges. Library and labs are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: The college is the best in the city with highly qualified teachers with the good surrounding.

content.Placements: The placement for our batch and our senior batched was average. Almost 40% of students got placed through campus placements. The highest salary package offered was 4.12 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 1.50 LPA. Many companies, like AISS Glasses, Byju's, Delhivery.com, etc., visited our campus for placements. Roles like trainee engineer, team lead, etc., were offered to students. Almost 10% of students got an internship at our college. The highest stipend offered was Rs. 5,000 during the internship. The lowest stipend offered was Rs. 2,000. The average stipend offered was Rs. 3,500. the placement cell in our college is good, which have 40% of efficiency to place students in good company.

reviews.review_heading: Bad college, bad campus, no placement, and bad behavior of teachers.
reviews.review_text: Bad meals and bad behavior of the warden. Bad labs, no equipment, dirty floors, and bad behavior of lab teachers. Bad facilities and bad behavior of teachers. No medicine was available in college, and the canteen staff had bad behavior. No sports games, huh.

reviews.review_heading: Worth the money, go for it.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of my university are awesome. Wi-Fi is available both on campus and in the hostels. The mess facilities are also good. The food provided in the hostel and canteen is great. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: College is decent, but prefer at least a preference type, not bad.
reviews.review_text: Department is too heavy timing, in fact, everything is decent, classroom, labs and Wi-Fi, but no off on the weekend. Mess and canteen are dirty, and cringe. Sports and games are too messy for all students, not a good investment in sports funding. In fact, the gym equipment is too old and corroded.

reviews.review_heading: Worth the money for the course.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in my course are very awesome, feels like home. The Wi-Fi facilities in classrooms and hostels are also good. The food facilities provided in the mess and canteen are very nice. Medicine facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: College is awesome.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructures of the college is very nice. Wi-Fi facility is available in both the hostel and campus. The rooms and facilities in the hostel are also good. The food provided in mess and canteen is also good. Medical and sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: If I may say, this college is perfect for every family, including middle-class families.
reviews.review_text: Every kind of facility is available in Jagannath University, like better speed Wi-Fi, advanced labs, better AC classrooms, and a library in which every kind of book is available. If we talk about the hostel, both AC and non-AC rooms are available in this college.

reviews.review_heading: My college provides me with the best knowledge that enhances my skills.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with Wi-Fi at all times and has good labs where we gain valuable knowledge from all the experiments. The classrooms are spacious and have Wi-Fi, creating an excellent environment with clean facilities. The library has all the necessary resources, and the canteen facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is available, and classrooms have AC facilities. The library has a wide range of books. Hostels food is very delicious. The medical facilities are good, and sports facilities are very good. The mess food is also very delicious. Games are well played by players and the club.

reviews.review_heading: There is scope in Physiotherapy from Jagannath University Jaipur.
reviews.review_text: Facilites available in my department are Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, seminar hall, auditorium, etc. The quality of facilites in the hostel is good. The quality of food in the mess is nice but in the canteen, it is okay. Medical and sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Jagannath University has good ingratiating and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Best facilities and infrastructure are there. Every equipment is available in pharmacy lab. Wi-Fi is also there. The quality of food in canteen is good. Good quantity of books is there in the library. Every Saturday, free sports and games are conducted for students. Gym equipment is also good. Classrooms are clean and standard.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities, such as Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and libraries, are there. Mess and canteen also have hygiene and a clean environment with proper management. All things are provided for sports. Many opportunities are also provided in a proper manner.

reviews.review_heading: Jagannath University: A delightful place for me.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure for our course are very good; everything is available for the students to do programming. Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and libraries are well maintained. The facilities provided in the hostel are also very good; everything is on time. Food quality is also good here, and everything else is also present here.

reviews.review_heading: Please take admission at your own responsibility.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the course is not valuable because all systems are old and very poor; they are used only for garbage, so the infrastructure is not good. The hostel is good for living, and the food is average. All things are average, like cleaning, and management is not good here.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, I am satisfied.
reviews.review_text: The food served in the hostel is decent. The playground is available for sports like cricket, football, and volleyball. The medical facilities are good. There are separate blocks for every branch and sufficient labs for practical knowledge. The classrooms are neat. The Wi-Fi is enabled. The library is good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college for the BBA course.
reviews.review_text: University is having a good infrastructure for the BBA course. Facilities such as library, canteen, sports, Wi-Fi, etc., are of decent quality. College has a pretty good campus. Bus stop is located at walkable distance. Canteen food is good to eat. Other necessary facilities are also available in the college.

paragraphs: OmDayal Group of Institutions admission 2025is currently open. The institutions offer courses, such as BTech, BArch, BBA, MArch, etc., at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the institute also offers BTech Lateral Entry courses. Candidates will be selected based on entrance exam scores and counselling to get admission to OmDayal Group of Institutions. Further, the institution is affiliated withMaulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology.The institute offers six courses in various streams such as Architecture, Engineering, etc. The application process atOmDayal Group of Institutionsis conducted online. reviews.review_heading: Quality of education, research opportunities, good campus life, and career resources.
reviews.review_text: We have multiple labs with all desirable software with AC enabled. Classrooms are well-maintained. There is a central library with a sufficient number of books. The infrastructure of hostel is appreciable with Wi-Fi enabled. Canteen facilities are there on college campus.

reviews.review_heading: Build our future with OmDayal.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is very good. Labs are very good and all the necessary tools are there in laboratory. Classrooms are also clean and smart classrooms are also available for visualisation of topics. All the books related to the scores if available in the library.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very good for engineering.
reviews.review_text: Our college is well-equipped in terms of laboratories, classrooms, libraries, and canteen. Wi-Fi is available everywhere inside the campus. Separate hostels are provided for both boys and girls. All the computer labs are updated with different software.

reviews.review_heading: The College is really nice and I would recommend this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good for this college. The college also has a ragging-free campus. The Wi-Fi is also good and free for all. The labs have all the equipment needed, and the classrooms are also really good. The college hosts sports also so that everyone gets a chance.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very good for engineering.
reviews.review_text: Our college is well-equipped in terms of both laboratories, classrooms, libraries, canteen. Wi-Fi is available every where in side the campus. Separate hostels are available for both boys and girls. All the computer labs are updated with different software.

reviews.review_heading: It is a ragging free campus.
reviews.review_text: For Computer Science and Engineering, well-furnished and updated labs with important software are available in all laboratories. Apart from that, other labs like Physics, Electrical, Workshop, Digital Electronics, etc., are also equipped with more than sufficient instruments.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with best infrastructure, ragging free campus and good environment.
reviews.review_text: Excellent facilities and infrastructure are available in our college, such as a gym, basketball, tennis, etc. Our hostel food is good. In labs, the conditions are good, but the machines are average. Our college organized inter-sports competitions.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with placement support and industry-level skill development.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is a positive point. Mess food is fairly good as well. Non-veg is included in the meal plan for hostelites. We used to get food 5/6 days a week. The only negative point is that even for going out of campus for 10 minutes, students must issue a gate pass, for which the student's guardian has to talk to the hostel warden.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are good but very low on campus placements.
reviews.review_text: Only wired Wi-Fi is available. No wireless Wi-Fi is provided. Labs are well-facilitated. Classrooms are suitable for 30-60 students per class. Both online and offline libraries are available. Hostel rooms are offered for single occupancy or for two persons per room, as per the students' requirements. The canteen is good due to its hygiene and the quality of food. Different sports and games are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college has new CPUs. The hostel facility is good. It has Wi-Fi, a television, and other essential facilities. The specs of the New CPUs are Ryzen5, 8Gb ram, dedicated graphics card, and 500 solid state drive.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good facilities, placements, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All the basic facilities are available. High-speed Wi-Fi connectivity is available. There are well-maintained labs. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained. Both online and offline libraries are available in our college. You can find almost every book related to your course. There are two separate hostels for boys and girls. Both are in very good condition. Good quality and hygienic food is available in the canteen. There are very basic medical facilities. A lot of sports activities happen thro...

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is excellent. The library is peaceful and it has various books by renowned authors. Our college provides excellent internet connections in computer labs. Classrooms are very good and neat. Around 50-60 students can accommodate in each class. There are various labs for other departments. A playground is good. Our college has a canteen. They serve popular dishes.

reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty members but placements in engineering are avarage.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Classrooms and labs are very well mentioned and new. The hostel building is just opposite the college. The library is good and we get most books from there. There is no Wi-Fi for students. There are no such playgrounds or sports facilities in our college.

reviews.review_heading: It is a private engineering and architecture college.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities like Wi-Fi, a library, and labs. Classrooms are in very good condition in our college. The quality of food served in the hostel is good and healthy. The playground is so good. Various sports are played on the campus. It also has a gym facility for fitness.

reviews.review_heading: I am happy to be an alumnus of OmDayal. I am thankful to my professors.
reviews.review_text: OmDayal is a fairly new college and still developing its infrastructure. Currently, facilities had improved a lot compared to facilities available during my tenure at our college. Cleanliness and hygiene are very well taken care of, and I must congratulate the non-teaching staff members on that base. B.Arch building is a reputed new one and very well decorated by the students.

reviews.review_heading: College is suitable for average students who want a decent education at an affordable price.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is decent and suitable for regular academic needs. Classrooms are spacious, and most of them are equipped with projectors. Labs are available for all departments, and are maintained reasonably well for practical learning. Library has enough academic books and reference materials, and reading space is calm. Wi-Fi is provided on campus, though speed may vary sometimes.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and above-average faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the institute is very good. The institute is mostly surrounded by trees. The classrooms are so nice. The ground in the Institute is so big. There is a good canteen in the institute. I like the ground side where students like to sit and eat. They provide accommodation to the students. The hostel is very good. They have separate hostels for boys' and girls'. The food is decent in this institution. The mess is neat and clean, and they provide quality food.

reviews.review_heading: My college is superb and the best.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available in my college are very good and the best. They provide 24-hour Wi-Fi in my hostel with no interruption. Library contains a lot of important books with all the requirements. There is a clean library space. The mess food is super neat and tasty.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with a nice campus and helpful teachers.
reviews.review_text: The college provides good facilities like clean classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a quiet library for study. Hostel rooms are decent and maintained, though the mess food is average but manageable. Basic medical help, sports, and games are also available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Annamacharya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Renigunta.
reviews.review_text: There are 4 blocks: A, B, C, and D. Blocks A, B, and C are constructed together, while block D is separate. Each block has 4 floors. Each floor has 8-10 rooms and also consists of a teachers' office, toilets for gents and ladies, and a computer lab. On the ground floor, we have an auditorium big enough to hold 500 students, a Physics lab, a Chemistry lab, and many more facilities. The hostel is also nice, and the food provided is good. However, the prices in the canteen are a bit high.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, excellent infrastructure, and supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very good. It has well-equipped computer labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a central library with plenty of resources. Hostel facilities are well-maintained, with clean rooms and 24/7 security. The mess food is hygienic. Taste is almost like restaurant food. Sports facilities, a gym, and medical facilities are available on campus. This makes student life comfortable and balanced.

reviews.review_heading: I was satisfied with the labs and teaching, but not that satisfied with the placements.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members of this college are friendly towards the studies, and they will encourage and help in various situations, like cultural activities, technical activities, extracurricular activities, and co-curricular activities. In classrooms, it contains a board, a table, benches, and a projector.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good. Regarding faculty, they are friendly with students.
reviews.review_text: A vast space is provided for everything. We have A/C in the labs. We have a big library where we have almost 500 books regarding all the branches, and also for other exam preparations. The class is also big, where easily 60 students can sit, and it is provided with 4 fans in each class.

reviews.review_heading: Best place to learn and grow with opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not available or permitted for students in the college. The labs, classrooms, and library are good, but the labs have limited equipment for experiments. The faculty members are friendly with students. Coming to the hostel, there is no Wi-Fi, but the food is good. However, there are no medical facilities in either the college or the hostel. Sports and games options are also lacking, as they are conducted only before certain events.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement opportunities, they encourage all students and well-behaved faculty.
reviews.review_text: No Wi-Fi options in college and hostel, food was so good in hostel, but wardens are the worst wardens, they ask money from students, and the labs and classrooms are clean and good. Sports are less they won't conducted, they are conducted before any events, that's it. Canteen is there in college, but the food is too expensive and not hygienic, so it's better to carry home-made food for your health.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college with strong faculty members, good placements, and a supportive campus.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure. It has spacious classrooms, well equipped labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a digital library. Hostel facilities are decent. Along with clean rooms, regular maintenance, and good security. The mess provides hygienic food with multiple options. Medical facilities are available on campus. Sports and cultural activities are well encouraged. They give students a balanced campus life.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not available or permitted for students in the college. The labs, classrooms, and library are good, but the labs have limited equipment for experiments. Coming to the hostel, there is no Wi-Fi, but the food is good. However, there are no medical facilities in either the college or the hostel. Sports and games options are also lacking, as they are conducted only before certain events.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college. The course curriculum is relevant to industry standards.
reviews.review_text: There are nearly 7 to 8 labs in the college. Classrooms are hygienic. The quality is nice. The college is surrounded by a good environment and is near Tirupati. The hostel facility is hygienic and good. The college canteen prices are minimal and worthwhile. Every weekend, we have sports hour and library hour.

reviews.review_heading: In my college, the placements are very good.
reviews.review_text: In my college, everything is good, including the infrastructure. The Wi-Fi is available 24 hours with unlimited data. The labs are very nice, and the library is very well-stocked with different types of books. The canteen is also very nice in our college.

reviews.review_heading: This college is good; everything is worth it, even in placements.
reviews.review_text: Good at everything, for example, the facilities and infrastructure are available in our college. We even have a good placement block for job interviews, and the hostel of this college has good facilities and quality food available in the mess and canteen.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in KUK for BSc course?

paragraphs: Kurukshetra University admission is granted on the basis of the entrance exam and merit list. The admission process includes filling out the application form, online choice filling & locking, release of merit list and fee payment. Given below is the step-wise admission process of Kurukshetra University:
1: Application

Candidates seeking admission to UG, PG, integrated and PhD programmes must visit the official website of the university (kuk.ac.in) to fill out the form and pay the application fee to complete the process of application.
2: Online Choice Filling & Locking

Online choice filling & locking by the candidate can be done as per key dates mentioned in the admission schedule for Govt./ Govt. Aided/SFS Colleges affiliated to Kurukshetra University, Kurukshetra. Students are allowed to fill in the multiple choices in order of preference as they wish.
3: Merit List Announcement & Fee Payment

Based on applicants' marks in an entrance exam, Kurukshetra University will release the merit list of selected students for the next round. For some of the courses, the merit list is released based on candidates aggregate in the last qualifying examination. Students who get their names on the admission list are then requested to visit the concerned college to report, upload documents and pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

The total fee of Kurukshetra University for any of the courses is a cumulative of multiple components such as tuition fees, hostel fees, security deposit, etc. Students may have to pay the fee semester-wise or yearly as asked by the university.Kurukshetra University feesalso vary from one course to another (even for specialisations).

Coming to the affordability aspect of Kurukshetra University courses, multiple scholarships and education loans are available for students. However, meeting the eligibility criteria for those scholarships and education loans is still a challenge for many. faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Kurukshetra University?
faqs.answer: Generally, candidates cannot get direct admission in Kurukshetra University for any of the courses. However, some lateral entry options are available for candidates. Also, some seats are reserved for certain candidates, such as those belonging to the defence personnel category, etc. They can get admission in the university through a special selection process.

faqs.question: How much percentage is required for admission to KUK?
faqs.answer: For Kurukshetra University admission to courses such as BE/ BTech candidates must have secured a minimum aggregate of 45% in Class 12 with PCM/PCB. For Kurukshetra University postgraduates courses, students must have secured a minimum aggregate of 45% to 55% in their last qualifying examination. For more KUK course-wise minimum eligibility criteria, candidates are advised to contact the admission department of the University.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for Kurukshetra University BSc course?

KUK admissions shall be made based on information furnished by the candidate and documents uploaded. Original documents will be verified when candidates visit for physical counselling on the premises of the Institute. Therefore, candidates are advised to fill out the online application form with correct details and upload documents as per the qualifications mentioned in the form.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in Kurukshetra University for BCA with 60% in Class 12th?
faqs.answer: Yes, all candidates who managed to secure a minimum aggregate of 50% are eligible to apply for BCA courses at Kurukshetra University. The admission process for BCA courses is a merit based process, taking into account the actual aggregate scored by a candidate. A 60% aggregate in Class 12th is sufficient to get BCA admissions at Kurukshetra University, according to the available data.

The median package offered to MBA students in 2024 was INR 4 LPA.
Moreover, 11 BPharma and 4 MPharma students were placed during the the 2024 drive. The median package offered to the BPharma and MPharma batch 2024 was INR 1.97 LPA and INR 2.96 LPA, respectively.

hostel_campus.college_name: Kurukshetra University (KUK) Infrastructure: Campus Facilities

hostel.description:
The University at present has 25 Hostels (11 for Boys, 1 for Foreign male students and 13 for
Girls) on the sprawling campus of the University. The girls’ hostels provide all important facilities
within the complex. These include common Gym., common reading hall, ATM, photocopy facilities, computer lab and many more. Each hostel on the campus operates its own mess providing hygienic and nutritious meals with a varied menu. In view of a large number of applicants seeking hostel accommodation, the University allows hostels to the students on the basis of their merit in the admission list. Most of the hostels have reading rooms, computer lab., common rooms and Indoor & Outdoor games facilities. The University has also made available the facility to male hostlers for parking their vehicles in the central parking near their hostels. The girls’ hostels are also provided with round the clock ambulance services and a dispensary. The hostel accommodation is subject to availability of seats.

Technical, Reference and provides open access to its books and periodical’s collection. The buildings are centrally air-conditioned and with all modern amenities for the reading of the students which remain open from 9.00 a.m. to 12.00 midnight on all the days throughout the year.

reviews_list.review_title: This is a great platform to learn and enhance your skills and qualities for a better future.

review_content.Placements: Phonics Group of Institutions is a college under Shri Dev Suman University which helps the students to enhance their skills and knowledge for their better future. The placement cell of this college helps the students to get a good package as their perfect job. 68% of students were placed in many famous companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has attractive infrastructure like libraries with updated books, Wi-Fi facility, and properly well-furnished laboratories and classrooms. Our college has good facilities for hostel rooms, food, cleaning, etc. Sports and games are organized by the college for the students to maintain their physical health.

reviews_list.review_title: I'm very satisfied because of faculty.

reviews_list.review_title: It’s really good because it is apprenticeship-embedded

review_content.Placements: If we are talking about the placements, it is pretty good, but the CTC is not up to the mark. 100% of the people got internships, and after that, placement was also 100%, but only a few companies came for placement like OM Logistics and other logistical companies. They offer roles like warehouse executive, operations executive, logistics coordinator, and so on.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty well. We have one basketball court and a badminton court. Other than that, Wi-Fi and fully digital classrooms are available. Talking about the mess food, I will say it’s okay, and you can’t expect too much, but it’s nice comparatively.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Decent and affordable option to study Naval Architecture.

review_content.Placements: Really hardworking placement. Though it's an exclusive industry, the placement cell tries their best to get the student placed. Ship design firms are the primary recruiters. Consider yourself blessed if classification societies and big shipyards show up.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel is really cozy and comfortable. Clean and decent ambience. Calm and serene environment for students to study. Mess food is delectable for a university. Free Wi-Fi is available. The campus gets extremely hot in summers and extremely cold in winters.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Amazing environment for those who are interested in academics.

review_content.Placements: I have enrolled in a B.Teach in Naval Architecture and Shipbuilding. My batch strength is 50 students; however, there is another batch of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering with 50 students. The first-year batch consists of 100 students, 50 in shipbuilding and 50 in ocean engineering. Most of the students get internships in firms like Vedam located in Mumbai or different shipyards in the third year of their course. We have a placement record of 95 percent as of this year, and some students opted for higher studies, and a few were not interested in sitting for the placements. Top recruiting companies include the IRS (Indian Register of Shipping), located in Mumbai, and L&T, which is located in 3 different states. According to requirements, students are placed in different sections. The top role that is offered after graduation is that of surveyor in the IRS itself.

individual_reviews.course: Apprenticeship Embedded (BBA) in Maritime Logistics - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with faculty members and good experience.

content.Placements: Everyone in our class got selected by good companies. Even though colleges could try to get top companies, they are bringing just decent companies. But after every batch, this apprenticeship opportunity is getting better.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are fully ventilated. But the hostel and mess are not good. Many people got typhoid last semester. The buildings are still under some construction and soon they will be finished. The third floor of the campus is also being renovated so more students can be enrolled.

individual_reviews.course: Apprenticeship Embedded (BBA) in Maritime Logistics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The new style of education with IMU Visakhapatnam.

content.Placements: In Indian Maritime University, Visakhapatnam, I'm studying BBA logistics, and it is an apprenticeship-based course. The total there are 6 semesters (3 years). The first 4 semesters are class programs only, and the last year is an apprenticeship. The highlight of these courses is that they are core-based courses. And for completing these courses, we get a package of 3.20 LPA. It is a LSC (logistics skill council) like course. Therefore, all companies that are listed under these courses will also be available for the placement time. The college is providing 100% placement.

individual_reviews.course: Apprenticeship Embedded (BBA) in Maritime Logistics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It’s really good because it is apprenticeship-embedded

content.Placements: If we are talking about the placements, it is pretty good, but the CTC is not up to the mark. 100% of the people got internships, and after that, placement was also 100%, but only a few companies came for placement like OM Logistics and other logistical companies. They offer roles like warehouse executive, operations executive, logistics coordinator, and so on.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty well. We have one basketball court and a badminton court. Other than that, Wi-Fi and fully digital classrooms are available. Talking about the mess food, I will say it’s okay, and you can’t expect too much, but it’s nice comparatively.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Decent and affordable option to study Naval Architecture.

content.Placements: Really hardworking placement. Though it's an exclusive industry, the placement cell tries their best to get the student placed. Ship design firms are the primary recruiters. Consider yourself blessed if classification societies and big shipyards show up.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is really cozy and comfortable. Clean and decent ambience. Calm and serene environment for students to study. Mess food is delectable for a university. Free Wi-Fi is available. The campus gets extremely hot in summers and extremely cold in winters.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Amazing environment for those who are interested in academics.

content.Placements: I have enrolled in a B.Teach in Naval Architecture and Shipbuilding. My batch strength is 50 students; however, there is another batch of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering with 50 students. The first-year batch consists of 100 students, 50 in shipbuilding and 50 in ocean engineering. Most of the students get internships in firms like Vedam located in Mumbai or different shipyards in the third year of their course. We have a placement record of 95 percent as of this year, and some students opted for higher studies, and a few were not interested in sitting for the placements. Top recruiting companies include the IRS (Indian Register of Shipping), located in Mumbai, and L&T, which is located in 3 different states. According to requirements, students are placed in different sections. The top role that is offered after graduation is that of surveyor in the IRS itself.

Candidates have to register on this portal by making an online payment of INR 10,000/- towards the Counselling Fee. The Counselling Fee is nonrefundable if a seat is allotted on any campus in any programme; else INR 9000 will get refunded.
